text:
lina: Deploybot failed to publish multi-arch manifest for release v1.12.3 to eu-west-1 ECR. Canary rollout stopped. log:
```
PUT /v2/redwood/platform/manifests/sha256:abcd1234... 403 AccessDenied TagCondition: rejected 'prod-1.12.3'
```
Anyone seen tag-policy changes? @joel

deploybot: Automated: publish failed for image redwood/platform:prod-1.12.3 -> eu-west-1 (status=403). Canary halted. Rollout paused. run_id=build-5421

joel: I pushed a tag policy tweak last night to prevent cross-account pushes for `prod-*` tags (compliance request). I thought it only hit S3 artifacts, not ECR. Looking at CloudTrail, the deny fired for the deploy role.

sam: Can we pin the canary to the previous digest so traffic keeps flowing? I prefer pin+manual promote over touching IAM in a hotfix outside the change window.

maya: +1 pin. Also we should surface this in release notes as a known issue so support isn't surprised.

aaron: I can retag the previous manifest in eu-west as `canary-1.12.3` and update deploybot's mapping. That avoids changing IAM now. Schedule a change window Mon 02:00 UTC to reconcile the policy.

lina: Plan: 1) pin canary to previous digest sha256:abcd1234... 2) update release notes + state manual promote later 3) file INFRA-834 for policy follow-up (assign joel) 4) aaron to retag now and confirm :thumbsup:

aaron: Doing retag now. Command I used: 
```
aws ecr put-image --repository-name redwood/platform --image-tag canary-1.12.3 --image-manifest "$(aws ecr batch-get-image --repo-name redwood/platform --image-ids imageDigest=sha256:abcd1234 --query 'images[0].imageManifest' --output text)" --region eu-west-1
```

aaron: Retag complete, updated deploybot mapping to point canary -> sha256:abcd1234. Running smoke tests.

deploybot: Automated: canary mapping updated per request. Traffic resumed to digest sha256:abcd1234... Monitoring: p50=40ms, 5xx=0 (first 5m)

joel: INFRA-834 created with CloudTrail snippets and proposed policy change to scope `prod-*` allow to the deploy role only. Also added rollback steps if we decide to revert the policy.

maya: Release notes updated under Known Issues: "eu-west-1: prod tag publish failed during canary promotion; canary pinned to previous digest. Manual promote scheduled after policy review."

lina: Thanks. Thread decision: pin canary (done), don't hotfix IAM, open INFRA-834 for policy work, manual full publish in change window. Closing this thread.
